My dear [Florence](/person/1520)
You have a birthday so seldom that one recollects it, so pray accept my best wishes and this tiny book.[^1] I am afraid there is a little black speck on its cover, but do not look to reject it on that account I hope you received the second volume of Thrupp on the Psalms. I do not like all of him, though I have learnt a great deal from him, he does not tread in the beaten lines.
I hope this warmer weather is refreshing you, it has brought up a great crowd of snow drops, and some primroses, but the Lent Lilies lag behind Lent.

With love to [your sister](/person/1519), and kind regards to [the General](/person/1521)

Yours affectionately

C M Yonge


[^1]: 1880 was a leap year, and Wilford\'s birthday was evidently on the 29 February.
